g.text: Population accuracy across the shared development panel
Equal-parent means +/- sample SD across eight VAL simulations; one completed fit per method

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #49525b

g.text: H047 matched original-risk and balanced-risk arms are shown separately
Each panel uses its own horizontal range. SD bars describe parent variation, not confidence intervals or optimizer-seed variation.
Present182 is primary; the other cohorts are descriptive. BronzeAge is not assumed identical to the paper's Post-Neolithic cohort.
Native objectives/budgets are retained. H045 and both H047 arms use H042 warmstarts +30 passes /960 updates per arm, seed101.
